name: If Miku situation.1 Imadoki no Joshi Kousei
original_name: If・ミク situation.1 今時の女子高生
source: One morning, you wake up to find out that Miku is your little sister and everyone seems to recognize it that way. You have no choice but to continue your life with that fact.
translation: 某天早晨，你醒来，发现初音未来成了自己的妹妹，而且所有人似乎都认为，事情本就如此。你别无选择，只能接受这个事实，继续生活。
